crossRefs.note: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for…
They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and…
Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…

translations.web: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”
translations.bsb: When daylight came, the magistrates sent their officers with the order: “Release those men.”
translations.kjv: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
translations.asv: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, Let those men go.
